  in the audience to provide comment or make inquiries on matters appearing on this Special
  Meeting agenda only. Although no person is required to provide their name and address as a
  condition to attending a meeting, persons who wish to address the body are asked to state their
  name and address. Each speaker will be limited to three (3) continuous minutes. Speakers may
  not lend any portion of their speaking time to other persons or borrow additional time from other
  persons. All comments or queries presented by a speaker shall be addressed to the body as a
  whole and not to any specific member thereof. No questions shall be posed to any member of the

  disruptive to the orderly conduct of the proceedings, including, but not limited to, conduct that

Gabriel Ramirez – I know we have a special meeting an emergency meeting today which
I find it ironically and this pertains to the agenda items 7.1 and 7.2 with the absence of
Mayor Ancona and I know Vicky is over there via zoom. I would find it very appalling that
this agenda whether it be true or not under based on what I read and basically, we received
a text message about in regards to Councilwoman so I would respect that we would use
that for the next meeting for transparency at the regular meeting with full body. This sis
not a need an urge to do this because again this is a waste of time for today for a special
emergency meeting and that is really not transparency I really urge the Council to really
change it for the next meeting and urge for a not a vote for today.

Angela Lee – Thank you so much for the opportunity just to speak and share as an
invested resident of the City of El Monte I count myself as someone who measures my
words very carefully, and does my best to only speak when I feel convicted to do so. I
hope that it is with that heaviness that you hear my words tonight. It is with a heavy heart
that I call in tonight and honestly, I'm calling asking for the humble resignation of Vicky
Martinez Muela. Councilwoman Vicky Martinez Muela has been someone that I've
respected as I've watched her career and service in El Monte. I’ve admired her dedication
to the next generation so much, and how it appears as though her faith is really the force
that propelled her to bring good to her community. [inaudible] endeavored in this effort in
that beginning. As a woman of Christina faith honesty and confession are two huge parts
for those of us who call ourselves Christ followers. Now I am not here to throw stones that
is not what I do, I am not here to pass assertions. However Councilwoman Martinez
Muela’s integrity has been called into question badly and whether true or not as this story
unfolds it’s an unfortunate deterrent from the very pressing matters that face out City. As
someone who is sworn to represent the people of El Monte Councilwoman Martinez Muela
should not let anything not even alleged accusations against her get it the way of the
business of the City going forward. Case in point all of these people on the dais who have

  2
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of July 29, 2021

very full lives who are leaders in our community are now together again today because of
this issue. [inaudible] professional ministry's integrity and decency integrity decency
should be her sole motivation here instead of self-protection and crime and even if all
these turns out to be true then just tell us the truth and give us the opportunity as the
community loves you to show you grace and forgiveness and show us how you can lead
with truth and transparency. And if it comes up it’s not true then trust the residents of El
Monte to reelect you later on for the same reasons that we trusted to vote for you in the
past if that’s still an option. Councilwoman Martinez Muela please, please give us an
opportunity to show other young people what to do when they have to face the
consequences of their actions. Our children are watching, and I would ask that you show
them what real integrity looks like, and step down in light of the allegations that have been
made against you.

Anonymous – I find it odd and sad that Mayor Pro Tem Martinez-Muela was the subject
of a Los Angeles Times article regarding several FPPC violations to which she admitted
to the investigative reporter, is the same women who criticized the former mayor of a lack
of transparency. Where was her transparency in reporting her medical procedure, that if it
truly was a medical issue, her health benefits would have paid. Having a lobbyist pay for
a vacation that she obviously could not afford and did not report the gift. Where is her
transparency in reporting of $1500 for a non-profit start-up that did not happen or where
happened to the donations collected as a fundraiser for veterans, children and seniors,
deposited into her campaign account, yet another reporting violation. I am sure several or
all of her supporters think these egregious acts will just go away or that they are lies made
up by Team El Monte or the former mayor. These same people are thinking, no not Vicky,
she couldn’t do these things but yet the Times has documentation, they have fact checkers
and attorneys to ensure the facts presented in the article are true. These are not lies but
facts! So what happens next? The City is very limited to what they can do in regards to
these violations. Censure is the only thing, a slap on the hand and told not to repeat your
violations again. But there is a strong pattern set over the past several years of not
following the law. Rules and laws that ALL elected must follow and sign under perjury of
law. We have seen a South El Monte Mayor serve time for accepting a bribe. A former
City of Rosemead Councilman and Mayor Pro Tem serve time for accepting a bribe. I am
not sure if these two men were censured, if not, their violations warranted incarceration
after an investigation an investigation by the District Attorney not the City where the bribes
occurred. Her violations are a slap in the face to honest elected. Her mention of a medical
procedure is a slap in the face to those who have struggled with real health issues. Her
pattern of breaking the law has been proven, as a community we have no other recourse
but to ask her to step down rather than the poor option of censure.

Anonymous – How many times does the City of El Monte have to come out in the news,
in a negative light. 1st. US and World Report on News about El Monte Police Award.
Now, this violation of the law and Trust by “OUR MOST SENIOR COUNCILWOMAN, Ms.
Victoria Martinez-Muela., should have known better. Is it a Loan or a Gift? 1. Whether it
was a loan it exceeded the amount that should have been reported by Law. If it was a Gift
it also, exceeded the amount required by Law! It needed to be reported. As , the MOST
SENOR Council-member you should have known better. You represent over 118,000
Residents. I’m all the many decades I have lived here, this is a profound disappointment!
As, Senior Council-member you should have known better.

Anonymous – Just in case the attorney again limits time for comment, I will get straight to
the point. I believe this special meeting of the City Council was called because of the latest
attempt of one side of the Council slandering the other by going to the press. I have read

  3
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of July 29, 2021

  the article and am disappointed, not in Vicki, but in those that thought it was appropriate
  to air out personal matters. How dare Vicki need a friend in an hour of need? How dare
  she believe that she has the right to separate personal from professional relationships? In
  essence, how dare she be human? In other words, this personal matter is no one’s
  business. I hope that when reviewing the article people remember the source. The
  allegations are coming from someone that somehow managed to secure not one, but two,
  of the very limited allotted business licenses for Cannabis sales. If anything, that is
  something worthy of investigation – how was she able to obtain two? It would be an
  understatement to say that here is a person who is, for lack of a better reference, bitter,
  that their potential windfall fell through. In addition, to allege that Vicki had anything to do
  with the Cannabis fiasco that feel apart is absurd. If you go back to the actual meetings,
  you would see that Ancona/Martinez frequently lost to the 3/2 vote on all these matters.
  The city would not be in this situation, with all these lawsuits, if it were not for the direction
  of then mayor Quintero. This is also likely one of the primary reasons Velasco and
  Quintero were voted off the council. I am nearly positive that the other party in play with
  this allegation and article is the El Monte Leadership Council. Individuals hiding behind
  the anonymity and claiming to consist of “everyday citizens, small business owners, and
  other community stakeholders” per their own website: elmonteleadershipcouncil.org. I
  believe the primary members of said leadership council is the former mayor, Andre
  Quintero, former councilman Jerry Velasco, councilwoman Maria Morales, councilwoman
  Alma Puente, perhaps councilman Martin Herrera and other “stakeholders.” Now I make
  that assertion because on the June 16, 2021 Facebook post from the El Monte Leadership
  Council – someone states “on behalf of us on the El Monte City Council” and I am fairly
  certain Mayor Ancona isn’t going to slander herself. A funny thing though. When going to
  the website www.elmonteleadershipcouncil.org and clicks on the CONTRIBUTE link – you
  are sent to emcouncil.campaignrep.org. For those of you who watch the Council meetings,
  a few months back Mayor Ancona brought up vendors that who are skewed toward one
  side of the Council or the other. What needs to investigation is why was one of the City’s
  vendors, CAMPAIGNREP INC, which was paid in excess of $80,000 dollars since last
  year, receiving and managing the contributions for political candidates while being a
  vendor for the City. Forget being a contribution in kind, this is a misappropriation of funds
  and more accurately – pay for play. Moreover, this hypocritical, integrity lacking,
  leadership council has the audacity to go to the press because their political opponent
  needed a favor and thought she could reach out to a friend. In the words of one of the
  gentlemen who is a regular at these council meetings --- SHAME!
